# 2022 FIFA World Cup Results

## Tournament Results

One source reports that Argentina won the 2022 FIFA World Cup by defeating France in the final. [1] One source reports that French player Kylian Mbappé finished as the tournament's top scorer with eight goals, winning the Golden Boot. [1]

## Sources

1. [2022 FIFA World Cup - Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2022_FIFA_World_Cup) — wikipedia.org, published 2008-06-03, fetched 2026-10-31
